ctx.x: That, uh, tuxedo, uh, band, was that the Celestan band? Yeah, it was Celestan, yeah. Who were the, did the personnel change any between the string band and the, uh, marching band, or did they just change instruments?

No, they, they add on to the marching band. It's like the, kind of time, the bass, the tuba player would double on string bass. And they'd use the Sam, uh, Celestan always had another trumpet with him. He used two trumpets. Sam trombone.
Did they, uh, ever have any instruments, did they ever have any other string instruments beside the bass, like violin?
